question: True or false: in 2019, women's sport took about a quarter of the airtime on US television sports news and highlights?
answer: False. Cooky, Messner and colleagues, who have measured this since 1989, found women's sport got 5.4% of airtime in 2019, and only 3.5% without that year's Women's World Cup. Fans cannot follow athletes they never see, so the coverage gap feeds the audience gap it is blamed on.
move: Ask whether an audience is missing because it was never shown anything.
ask: Is there something I assume nobody wants, when really nobody has been shown it?
trap: Recalling a few famous stars and guessing their coverage is large.
reference: Cooky, Council, Mears & Messner, One and Done: The Long Eclipse of Women's Televised Sports, 1989–2019, Communication & Sport, 2021
